title: compat: negotiate events stream format from Accept
body:
Fixes #30330

This is the events Accept item from #30164, plus the jsonl part from #30165. Newer docker clients send Accept with jsonl, x-ndjson and json-seq on GET /events and pick their decoder from the Content-Type we send back, so I added a small q-value aware helper in apiutil and use it in the compat events handler. json-seq records get the RS prefix. As with Docker, the API version picks the default (application/json below 1.52, application/jsonl from 1.52) and Accept only overrides it when it asks for jsonl, x-ndjson or json-seq. Libpod requests still get plain application/json.

There's a unit test for the negotiation, one for the version gating, and an apiv2 check on the returned Content-Type.
